description_en: Invokes the UpdateVirtualBorderBandwidth operation to update the bandwidth throttling for both the upload and download directions on a Virtual Border Router
description_zh: 调用UpdateVirtualBorderBandwidth接口更新边界路由器上下云双方向的带宽限速
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-virtual-border-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --virtual-border-router-id vbr-bp15zckdt37pq720000 --bandwidth 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVirtualBorderBandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
VBR所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The new bandwidth limit of the VBR. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的VBR限速带宽，单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the modification was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
是否修改成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
